claims.statement: The mechanical lion: The automaton in the form of a lion, which walked and opened its breast to disclose lilies, is known through later testimony, above all Lomazzo (1584); it is associated by different sources with the entry of Francis I into Lyon in 1515 and with a presentation at Argentan in 1517. No contemporary document assigns its construction to the Amboise years, and it should be handled at tier C or below

sources.loc: section XIII, Notes on contested and commonly misstated points
